pull_request.title: hw/misc: add verified SM8250 DDR statistics offset reference
pull_request.body:
## Why this is needed

The qualified RPM offset build `66d9e20a9541b503ed4f5cac5c79c8a5b4a0809b` progressed beyond the previous RPM offset access and stopped in the unchanged original Android kernel at `ddr_stats_probe+0x88/0x180`: instruction `b9400018` (`LDR W24,[X0]`) reading four bytes at physical `0x0c3f001c`. The [bounded native evidence and independent review](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/qemu-tb371fc/blob/ec36e1d92d28da62882d3ad915e04c13738a7935/tb371fc/evidence/rpm-stats-offset-66d9e20-ci-20261125-6a5/native/README.md) retain the kernel failure, unchanged original inputs, zero-LUN selection and normal QEMU cleanup. Android userspace, UI and boot completion remain unobserved.

This change addresses that exact offset-word access. It is based on merged RPM commit `420819df9cfd76dc98cb4705987c269047d7f214`, whose tree is identical to the qualified RPM source.

## Resulting behavior

- Add `qcom-sm8250-ddr-stats-offset`, default disabled. Only an enabled reference profile maps the exact four-byte leaf at `0x0c3f001c`.
- An enabled aligned 32-bit read returns `0x000f00b8`. Writes, narrow/unaligned/typed 64-bit reads and surrounding holes remain rejected. A raw five-byte read checks its valid four-byte prefix and independently rejects the neighboring byte; failed suffix values are not interpreted.
- The disabled profile leaves the address unmapped. This preserves the existing RPM suite's neighboring-hole contract without changing any RPM model, source-generation, compiled-test or acceptance-contract bytes.
- No DDR payload, magic, entry count, statistics record, counter, duration, firmware execution, READY signal, IRQ, clock or timer is provided. The separate RPM model and existing AOP mailbox aperture retain their behavior.
- The QOM device remains present in both profiles with 17 pure observations. VMState v1 is exactly 24 bytes with distinct `DSO1` identity. Loading validates the configured target profile, identity, geometry and profile-specific offset without repair or enabling a disabled region.

The offset value is an explicit reference layout. Rejecting APSS writes is the model's consumer boundary; it is not a claim that physical shared SRAM is immutable or that its reset value was measured.

## Source evidence

Four complete public inputs are pinned by byte count, SHA256 and Git blob identity before parsing: vendor `ddr_stats.c` and `kona-pm.dtsi` at OnePlus commit `98719830b0de5584f5588bbe9f4c8304d97a64c6`, and upstream `qcom_stats.c` and `sm8250.dtsi` at Linux commit `75f2c0b3690702c90863c2e138cb5520670845ea`.

The actual original full DT supplies resources `0x0c300000/0x1000` and `0x0c3f001c/4`. Independent decoding of the complete 384-byte original probe confirms the four-byte read, unmap, zero-offset rejection and addition to the first resource base. The cold vendor probe does not read DDR payload bytes. Public upstream uses a different cold-probe access pattern; that distinction remains explicit.

The matching upstream SM8250 layout derives `0x0c3f0000 + 0xb8 - 0x0c300000 = 0x000f00b8`. Bounded static analysis of the existing backed-up AOP firmware corroborates this arithmetic. It does not prove live producer execution, reset reachability, a general address alias or current hardware data. No private firmware image or raw original-kernel slice is published.

## Verification prepared in this change

- Independent static C, glue, generated-source and test reviews; exact preservation of the prior RPM files.
- Positive regeneration from all four complete public inputs, reproducing both generated outputs byte-for-byte.
- Rejection of four whole-input one-bit mutations, 32 parser-negative vectors, one complete bad transport identity without retry and two generated-output mutations.
- Twenty compiled-QEMU test groups: enabled boundaries, actual disabled flat-view absence, paused TCG, two completed migrations, both profile-mismatch directions and six one-bit corrupted streams.
- Full 24-byte wire verification for two original/eight total stream files. For both completed migrations, each target has two separate 17-getter observations before restored RAM checks, active mapping queries or `cont`; prewarming changes only RAM.
- The CI plan is 99 component gates plus five Linux diagnostics. All previous 102 contracts and their order are retained. The host harness has 36 unit tests.

The actual local host-unit run executed all 36 tests: 35 passed and one unchanged socket-fixture test failed at AF_UNIX socket creation because this environment returned EPERM. Its full failure record is retained. It was not rerun, skipped or reclassified as a complete pass; formal CI must pass all 36.

**This draft is pending actual compiled CI, exact artifact/log audits and a separately bound original-input native diagnostic. No new native execution or Android success is claimed.**
